title: 6 Days Best of Grand Alaska Highlights Tour
includes: Guided Hikes in the National Parks, Expert local tour guide throughout
Public transportation (bus, subway, cable car, etc.)

blurb:
Explore the majestic landscapes of Alaska on an unforgettable journey from Seward to Denali. This small-group tour features scenic drives along the Seward Highway, wildlife encounters at the Alaska Wildlife Conservation Center, and a glacier cruise through Kenai Fjords National Park. Enjoy guided hikes to stunning vistas, delve into gold rush history at Independence Mine, and experience a full-day wildlife tour in Denali National Park. With expert local guides and all logistics taken care of, immerse yourself in the beauty and charm of the Last Frontier at a relaxed pace.

- Guaranteed departures and small group sizes for a personal experience
- Includes 5 breakfasts, 5 lunches, and expert local tour guide throughout
- Scenic journeys aboard the Alaska Railroad and the Alyeska Tram
- Optional glacier landing flight seeing tour available (weather permitting)
